title: Music SMP Discs
description: Adds 31 custom music discs (more soon) that when right clicked play a song and give an ability.
body:
**This is the official datapack used in Music SMP. It adds 31 music discs that when right clicked play a song and give an ability.**

# Get It Working
Do 
```
/function musicsmp:init
```
 to set the scoreboard values for each player. It should start working from there.

# Command For Each Disc:

They have to be put into a command block to work

## Update 1:

### Harder, Better Faster, Stronger: 
```
give @p minecraft:carrot_on_a_stick[  minecraft:custom_name={text:"Harder, Better, Faster, Stronger",bold:true,italic:false,color:"aqua"},  minecraft:lore=[    {"text":"By: Daft Punk","italic":false,"color":"aqua"},    {"text":"Applies speed, haste, strength, and resistance.","italic":false,"color":"green"}  ],  minecraft:custom_data={song:"faster"},  minecraft:item_model="musicsmp:faster", ]
```
